profile.name: MP71025X可编程直流电源
profile.description: MP71025X是一款实验室用可编程直流电源，用于为电子电路、器件和样品提供可调直流电压与电流，并支持输出开关、远端感测以及电压、电流、功率测量，适合台式测试、器件表征和一般电子实验。
profile.description_en: The MP71025X is a laboratory programmable DC power supply used to provide adjustable DC voltage and current to electronic circuits, devices, and samples. It supports output on/off control, remote sensing, and measurement of voltage, current, and power for benchtop testing, device characterization, and general electronics lab work.

registry.name: MP71025-X Motion
registry.description: MP71025-X Motion Controller 自动化设备是由Multicomp Pro生产的物流/机械，主要功能包括初始化、测量、电压设置、电流设置。
